@notice Deliberately broken hooked vault (read-only reentrancy): withdraw pays the assets out and
         runs the afterWithdraw hook BEFORE it burns the shares. Inside the hook totalAssets() has
         already dropped while totalSupply has not, so pricePerShare() is too low and any protocol
         that prices the share from inside the hook is manipulated. CI expects FoundryGuard's
         invariant_hook_readConsistency to FAIL on it.

@notice Uniswap v4 style hook interface: the vault calls the registered hook around its flows
         and requires the hook to answer with the function's own selector.
@notice Uniswap v4 PoolManager style callback: the caller is called back on `msg.sender`.

@notice Safe v4-style pool: deposit locks, calls the depositor back through unlockCallback before
         touching any state, then settles. Every Preset 04 invariant must PASS on it.
